summary: When you teach a biologist to write poetry you learn things mycorrhizal mishaps in firing synapses gashes in knowing dashed into verse so instead of one guy writing a poem we have four poets writing about fungi. #smallpoems #clmooc
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
When you
teach a biologist
to write poetry
you learn things
mycorrhizal mishaps
in firing synapses
gashes in knowing
dashed into verse
so instead of one guy
writing a poem
we have four poets
writing about
fungi.
#smallpoems
#clmooc
